standard_prerequisites.use: Definition of Gorenstein morphism of spaces (flat lfp with Gorenstein fibres, smooth-local on source and target), etale charts of algebraic spaces, and the schemes-side stability of the Gorenstein property under base change (cited from the schemes chapter).

core_obligations: Choose etale scheme charts of the source and of the new base.
Identify the pulled-back fibres with scheme-theoretic base changed fibres.
Apply the schemes stability and re-glue via the local-on-charts definition.

proof_roadmap.step: Schemes-side conclusion plus descent of the property to the space.

difficulty_reason: For a flat locally finite presentation morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S with Gorenstein fibres, the base change of f along any Y' -> Y has Gorenstein fibres again, i.e. the Gorenstein morphism property is fpqc/fppf-stable on the base in the definition's sense. The retained proof is written as a chart reduction: pick etale surjections from schemes V -> Y' and U -> X, form the fibre product scheme covering X x_Y Y', and note the fibre of the pulled-back map is the fibre of a base changed morphism of schemes at a point mapping to the given point; the schemes-side base-change stability of the Gorenstein property (the schemes chapter's result, cited) applies to the chart, and Gorenstein-ness of fibres descends along the etale surjection because it is smooth-local on source and target by the definition section the author references. Retained author proof at lines 6687-6702.

dedup.scope: Base-change stability of Gorenstein morphisms in the category of algebraic spaces.
